messages:
Ravi (CSM): Heads-up: EBR for NovaPay moved to Thu 2pm PT. Need a tight 20-min run: 6m exec ask, 6m demo, 6m health + action plan, Qs. Can we finalize slide owners and the three renewal flags by EOD?
Nora (CS Ops): I got usage patterns and billing spikes. Ian draft the spend trend + anomaly slide. Will also run a quick cohort churn calc.
Zoe (Solutions Eng): Ian own onboarding status and enablement playbook ask. Planning a one-page playbook mock for the support team. Need customer success stories to surface (short bullets).
Victor (Acct Exec): Ian draft the executive ask + renewal signal narrative. Heads-up: customer called out latency on peak batch inference as a top concern. I'll include a potential commercial concession ask.
Marta (Product): Quick note: roadmap item for "auto-fallback routing" will land in Q3; can add 2 lines about expected impact on reliability.
Ravi (CSM): Perfect. Let's capture the three renewal flags: 1) Compliance review delay, 2) Cost unpredictability, 3) Peak latency on batch jobs. Add mitigations next to each.
Zoe (Solutions Eng): Mitigations: compliance -> template SOW + legal touchpoint; costs -> cost cap patterns + tagging; latency -> dedicated instance + perf tuning. I'll write a one-line mitigation per flag.
Nora (CS Ops): For the cost slide, quick ask: attach the 7-day rolling spend graph and annotate the spike on 2025-03-07. Also will include estimated monthly delta if customer uses dedicated pool.
Victor (Acct Exec): I'll quantify the compliance ask (legal + SOC2 timeline) and propose a 90-day remediation checklist.
SchedBot: Reminder: EBR prep doc created -> https://docs.internal/redwood/nova-ebrs/3947654321 (edit access: #customer-success).
Ravi (CSM): Demo plan: Zoe + Victor run the product demo (Zoe walk through onboarding flows, Victor covers exec view + budget controls). Samir volunteered earlier to run a stability check for the quantized path — @Samir please confirm.
Samir (Eng): (joined thread) Confirmed. Iompleted a smoke run on a dedicated instance; no crashes but saw a 150ms tail latency on the quant path with long contexts. Will test a mitigation patch by Wed EOD.
Zoe (Solutions Eng): Demo flow draft (in doc):
```
- 0:00-0:30 Intro & ask (Victor)
- 0:30-3:00 Key workflows + onboarding wins (Zoe)
- 3:00-5:30 Live demo: failover + quant path (Samir)
- 5:30-6:00 Next steps & asks (Ravi)
```
Can people sanity-check the timing?
Nora (CS Ops): Timing looks good. One ask: keep each slide to one chart or one bullet list so the design handoff is quick.
Marta (Product): Added roadmap note to doc. Also added a short risk: the auto-fallback ETA depends on infra approvals.
Ravi (CSM): Great. Action items roll-up:
- Victor: Exec ask + compliance quant (Mon noon)
- Nora: Usage & cost slide + spike annotation (Wed COB)
- Zoe: Onboarding slide + support playbook draft (Tue COB)
- Samir: Demo stability validation + run link (Thu EOD)
- Ravi: Collate slides + run dry-run Thu 10am PT
Please react :white_check_mark: when done.
Victor (Acct Exec): Reacted. Drafting the exec ask now.
Nora (CS Ops): Reacted. Pulling the annotated graph.
Zoe (Solutions Eng): Reacted. Will drop playbook draft by Tue.
Samir (Eng): Reacted. Will post run link when tests pass.
Ravi (CSM): One more item: customer feedback. Let's list 3 things they love and 3 pain points. I'll add mine: loves the API speed and docs; pain: surprise overage mitigation. Everyone add one each to the doc.
Zoe (Solutions Eng): Added: loves onboarding speed; pain: missing edge-case auth flow docs.
Nora (CS Ops): Added: loves visibility on per-route cost; pain: billing spike on 3/7 with no alert.
Victor (Acct Exec): Added customer quote about execs wanting predictable budget and a condensed SLA summary.
Ravi (CSM): Thanks all. I'll send calendar invite for Thu 10am dry-run and a 1-page pre-read 24h before. If anything urgent pops up, flag here. :rocket:
